verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a processor, and a built-in AI assistant you delegate tasks to is a software capability outside this product category. The Copilot+ mentions describe Microsoft's assistant running on Intel-enabled PCs, which is a host-platform feature rather than something the CPU itself ships. The NPU, OpenVINO and oneAPI items are hardware and developer building blocks, not a delegating assistant, so nothing here makes the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
